svg.title: Two Arms. Wall rack for a snowboard or skis, white oak

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: A wall rack in solid white oak for one snowboard or one pair of skis, with felt-lined arms and a single
brine shrimp burned into the rail from the same die as the pouch. Mounts to two studs with the hardware in the box.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: A 157 cm board, resting on the arms, base to the wall.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: The lip keeps the board from rolling off; the same
arms hold a pair of skis tip-up, bases to the wall.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Branded with a heated brass die, the pouch's shrimp at 2.75 inches.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Thirty inches of oak, two arms, one shrimp. It is the thing you screw into the wall of the first apartment

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: after the first season, and it says where you live without saying it.
